book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Apocalipsis Re kwaan mlu Jesucrist lo Juan

content: Lee mandad gaay mkwezh trompet cheen, zee myun tub mbal yiba lo na, ma ngob yiba nu mla lo yizhyo, nu mkayaa ma leyaw cheen yerdoo.
Nu mxal ma roo yerdoo, nu leen ba mroo zhen mod leen tub gor ndok doo. Nu lee zhen cheen yerdoo mle nagaas lo mbizh nu lo rese kwaan yiba.
Nu leen zhen ba mroo zyen doo mbeso nu mrech ma dubse yizhyo; nu mzaa xaa yalnayii lo ma mod lo nix.
Nu mxaal xaa ma, zee nanluuxt ma nik tub yix wen, nixa nik tub kwaan naye na, nixa re yag; nebse nzhaal kee maya cho re xaa kwaan nankeet sey cheen Dios lachuzh.
Per namzaat xaa diizh lo ma gut ma myet, nebse teed ma re myet bid tub gaay mbee; nu mod nkee maya lal kwentaxa nkee nixa.
Lee re mbizh zee lee re myet nzhekla yet per nayizhalt mod yet xaa lo xaa; nu nle re xaa xgab yet xaa, per nyent mod yet xaa.
Lee re mbeso nzhak mod kabay ma nya lo dil; nu yek ma nzob tub kwaan nzhak kwenta tub koron or, nu lee garlo ma nzhak kwenta garlo myet.
Lee yich yek ma nzhak kwenta yich yek ngwnaa, nu lee leyy ma nzhak kwenta leyy mbezh.
Lee laz ma nyaaw kwaan yiib, nu lee bi kwaan nzebi ma nyubi mod pa nzhaxonn zyen doo kabay, ma nzhano karret lo dil.
Nu lee xkol ma nzob xkoch ma kwaan nkee maya mod nix, nu nkano ma yalnabeyy kee maya cho re myet dubse tub gaay mbee.
Lee xaa nabeyy lo re mbeso, nak mandad cheen yerdoo; nu diizh hebreo le xaa Abadón nu diizh gryeg le xaa Apolión. (Wdizh ne nii: “Xaa nlux rese kwaan”.)
Mded yalzi kwaan yilotlaka, per seesa nzho jwalt xchopa.
Zee lee mandad xop mkwezh trompet cheen, nu mbin na tub bos kwaan mroo leen dap skin mdo or, kwaan nzob lo Dios.
Nu lee bos nzhé lo mandad ne, xaa mkwezh trompet: —Bsela dap mandad, xaa mkado Dios, roo yuu ndok kwaan le Éufrates.
Nu listla nzo Dios sela dap mandad xaa mkadoo nee, zee xek xaa xaa mer liin, mer mbee, mer mbizh, nu mer gor kwaan mlela Dios xgab, zee gut xaa tub part lo chon part re myet yizhyo.
Nu mbin na nzhé tub xaa: —Nzho kan chop gayoo miyon soldad, xaa nzob tich kabay.

Snee myun re kabay lo na, nu re xaa nzob tich ma nyaaw laz kwaan yiib kwaan nla xni naxne mod ki, nu nla xni sul mod ke le safiro nu nla xni nayech mod ke le azufre. Lee yek re kabay nzhak kwenta yek mbezh, nu roo ma nroo bal, zhen, nu azufre.
Nu tub part lo chon part lo re myet yizhyo yet lo re yalzi kwaan nroo roo re kabay: bal, zhen, nu azufre.
Nel lee re kabay nted yalzi kwaan roo ma nu kwaan xkol ma; nel lee xkol ma nzhak kwenta yek tub mball wiz, kwaan kee maya re myet.

Per lee re myet, xaa nanguta lo re yalzi ne, namlaat xaa naletra xaa re kwaan nawent kwaan nle xaa: seetaka nzholl re xaa lo re mandad cheen Maxuu, kwaan nak re maj, kwaan mdexkwaa kwaan or nu kwaan plat nu kwaan brons nu kwaan ke nu kwaan yag. Re maj ne nyent mod wii, nixa nyent mod gon kwaan nii re xaa lo, nixa nyent mod ze.

Nu seetaka lee re myet ne nanlaat naletra xaa kwaan nawent kwaan kale re myet ne; nu seetaka nzhut xaa sa myet xaa, nu seetaka nle xaa re yalwezh, nu seetaka nchaal xaa stub naz ngwnaa, nu seetaka nlewann xaa.
